body: Emirates is eyeing three new US cities for nonstop flights to Dubai, potentially expanding beyond the 12 American airports it serves today. President Sir Tim Clark named Denver, Detroit and Philadelphia as possible destinations during an interview at Routes World in Frankfurt this week, as reported by The Points Guy. None of the three airports currently has a nonstop connection to Dubai International Airport, and the carrier's most recent US route launch was Miami in 2021, replacing flights to nearby Fort Lauderdale.

Of the three, Philadelphia would be the shortest route at 6,928 miles from Dubai, followed by Detroit at 7,083 miles and Denver at 7,758 miles, although Denver would not become Emirates' longest US route, a title held by Los Angeles at 8,326 miles. Denver is the only United Airlines hub Emirates does not already serve, Detroit is one of Delta Air Lines' largest hubs, and Philadelphia is an American Airlines stronghold and key transatlantic gateway. Denver currently has no nonstop flights to the Gulf region, and its longest route is Turkish Airlines' 6,130-mile service to Istanbul, launched in June 2024.

Whether the routes happen depends heavily on restoring capacity and expanding the fleet. Emirates is still awaiting its first Boeing 777-9, with the first delivery expected in May or June 2027, seven years later than initially planned. Until then, it is extending the lives of its Airbus A380s and Boeing 777-300ERs through a $5 billion cabin retrofit program, and now expects to keep its A380s flying into the early 2040s. Emirates has not added a brand-new US airport since Miami in June 2021, before which its last addition was Newark in March 2017 via Athens.
en.summary: Emirates president Tim Clark named Denver, Detroit and Philadelphia as possible new US nonstop destinations to Dubai, with any launch depending on fleet deliveries and restored capacity.
en.title: Emirates eyes Denver, Detroit and Philadelphia for first Dubai nonstops

body: 阿聯酋航空正考慮新增3座美國城市直飛杜拜，有可能擴大目前服務的12座美國機場。總裁提姆·克拉克爵士本週在法蘭克福世界航線大會受訪時，點名丹佛、底特律與費城為可能的新航點，相關說法由積分達人報導。3座機場目前皆無直飛杜拜國際機場的航班，阿聯酋航空最近一次美國新航線是2021年開通的邁阿密，取代鄰近的羅德岱堡航班。
3條航線中，費城距杜拜6928英里最短，其次為底特律7083英里，丹佛7758英里最長，但丹佛仍不會成為阿聯酋航空最長的美國航線，該紀錄仍屬洛杉磯的8326英里。丹佛是聯合航空唯一尚未由阿聯酋航空服務的樞紐，底特律是達美航空最大樞紐之一，費城則是美國航空的重鎮與重要跨大西洋門戶。丹佛目前沒有直飛波斯灣地區的航班，其最長航線是土耳其航空2024年6月開通、飛往伊斯坦堡的6130英里航線。
新航線能否成真，很大程度取決於運能恢復與機隊擴張。阿聯酋航空仍在等待首架波音777-9，預計2027年5月或6月交付，比最初計畫晚7年。在此之前，該公司正透過50億美元客艙翻新計畫延長空中巴士A380與波音777-300ER的服役年限，並預計A380將飛入2040年代初期。自2021年6月開通邁阿密以來，阿聯酋航空未再新增美國機場，在此之前最近一次新增是2017年3月經雅典開通的紐華克。
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空總裁克拉克點名丹佛、底特律與費城為可能新增的杜拜直飛航點，新航線仍取決於機隊交付與運能恢復。
zh.title: 阿聯酋航空考慮新增丹佛、底特律與費城直飛杜拜
